text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to your birthday party, okay? 
After all, it was planned by none other 
than me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The cuisine covers the Eight Great 
Traditions, the music is a string octet, 
and the gift is a bouquet featuring 8 
varieties of birth flowers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wah~, sounds interesting! Though, why are 
there so many 8s?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Eight is considered an auspicious number. 
Quite the opposite of a jinx, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really~? ...Wait, was Kura-chan always 
the type to believe in that kind of stuff?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't think it's about believing or 
not believing, it's more of a mindset 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
When you're feeling down, good memories 
give you strength, right? So the more good 
luck you have, the better, wouldn't you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can understand that. Good memories 
make the core of your heart strong, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That's it. As long as you keep your 
mental state strong, adversity, jinxes, 
even destiny can surely be shattered."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I've grown a bit more mature too, so 
I want to train my heart to remain 
unshakeable, even when destiny comes 
poking at me.
